question: Do auxiliary Noisy Nodes denoising regularization and Relation Update Normalization combine constructively on GPTrans-T to outperform both isolated mechanisms and the baseline comparator?

hypothesis.observed_deficiency: The GPTrans-T baseline (0.156627 eV) suffers from representation over-smoothing and pair residual variance growth. Noisy Nodes (+0.004840 eV) and Pair Update Norm (+0.004843 eV) operate on orthogonal channels.
alternative_explanations: regularization interference where node perturbation disrupts pair relation normalization
saturation where one mechanism already captures all accessible residual signal
hypothesis.changed_mechanism: orthogonal combination of node embedding Gaussian perturbation (std=0.15, alpha=0.10) with LayerNorm normalized pair updates across all 12 blocks
hypothesis.cheapest_falsifier: 60-epoch 100K/50K run failing to outperform the single-mechanism comparator (0.151784 eV) with statistically favorable bootstrap interval
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: nominate the joint Noisy Nodes + Pair Update Norm architecture as the new primary GPTrans-T configuration for full-scale advancement
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: close the joint regularization route and retain isolated single mechanisms
